propositions: git fetch hangs for up to 300 seconds when a remote accepts connection but sends zero bytes, with no throughput-based abort mechanism
git fetch must be configured with http.lowSpeedLimit and http.lowSpeedTime to abort stalled connections in seconds rather than wall-clock timeout
in-process retry of transient low-speed aborts (bounded to a configured number of attempts) allows recovery within a single review instead of deferral to backfill
legitimately slow but progressing transfers must not be aborted; the abort mechanism must be keyed on throughput floor rather than wall-clock time
repo_snapshot.py exceeds the 800 LOC module-size cap and requires extraction of git-subprocess and fetch-locking cluster into a new sibling git_fetch.py module
